text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With results like these, I've got no right to be called Empress.
choice_data_list: Don't let it get to you too much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Win or lose, the next race awaits. I can't let failure cloud my future.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am fully aware of that. However, I refuse to let these feelings go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This frustration and anger… I'll bring all of it to bear in the next race!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh… You're saying I have to earn the title of Empress?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Quite the simplistic conclusion. It's very like you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But I suppose a simple problem calls for a simple solution—if I'm not worthy, then I just have to keep working until I am!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I must take myself to task for my shortcomings.
